name: Supabase
description: Developer/data platform: open-source backend-as-a-service with Postgres database, auth, storage and realtime APIs, plus a Management API for projects.
access_notes: Free tier sign-up; personal access tokens are self-generated from the dashboard account page, and OAuth2 apps for third-party integrations are created self-serve in the Supabase Dashboard.
mcp_notes: Official hosted vendor MCP at https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp (docs at supabase.com/docs/guides/ai-tools/mcp, repo github.com/supabase/mcp) with OAuth via dynamic client registration. Composio also lists a SUPABASE toolkit with 129 tools and managed auth.
uncertainty_notes: Project-level Data API (PostgREST/pg_graphql/realtime) uses project API keys/JWTs, while the account-level Management API uses PAT or OAuth2; both are self-serve. Database webhooks are a project feature enabled via the Management API.

evidence.note: Management API: 'two ways to generate an access token' - personal access token (PAT) or OAuth2, sent as Bearer in Authorization header; REST base https://api.supabase.com/v1.

OAuth2 authorization-code flow with PKCE (authorize at api.supabase.com/v1/oauth/authorize) is the documented path for third-party apps acting on behalf of users; OAuth apps created self-serve in the dashboard.
Official Supabase MCP Server docs: hosted at https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp, authenticates via OAuth dynamic client registration; repo github.com/supabase/mcp.
Composio SUPABASE toolkit: 129 tools, OAUTH2/API_KEY auth, Composio managed app available; tool list includes 'Enable project database webhooks'.
